title: valeriana stolonifera subsp. nitida
intro: Valeriana stolonifera subsp. nitida, commonly known as Japanese valerian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation, acting as a natural sedative and anti-anxiety agent. The therapeutic actions of Japanese valerian are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valepotriates and valerenic acid, which have been shown to have a calming effect on the nervous system and promote sleep. The bioactive constituents of Japanese valerian have also been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable plant for medicinal use.
